technologies.name: Playwright Test Agents
technologies.capability: Planner explores the application and creates a test plan; generator creates executable tests; healer reruns and proposes repairs.
technologies.setup: Playwright project, seed test, supported coding agent, target application
limits: Healing can hide real regressions without mutation gates
technologies.security: Use least-privilege test accounts and review tool permissions.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Playwright release or regenerated agent definitions

technologies.name: Promptfoo
technologies.capability: Declarative evaluation and red-team workflows for prompts, RAG, agents, custom targets, and CI.
technologies.setup: Node.js/npm or npx; provider credentials for live targets
limits: Generated attacks and graders need calibration
technologies.security: Isolate targets, redact secrets, pin CI context, and review generated probes.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Promptfoo release, plugin change, provider change, or new threat class

technologies.name: DeepEval
technologies.capability: Pytest-style LLM, RAG, and agent evaluations with built-in and custom metrics.
technologies.setup: Python package; judge model credentials for model-based metrics
technologies.security: Do not send unsanitized production traces to external judges.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Metric, judge model, package, or API version change

technologies.name: OpenAI Evals
technologies.capability: Primary repository for defining and running model/system evaluations.
technologies.setup: Python environment and target model configuration
limits: Repository behavior must be checked before adoption
technologies.security: Keep evaluation data and API credentials out of logs.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Repository release, API change, or maintenance-status change

technologies.name: Inspect AI
technologies.capability: Compose evaluation tasks from datasets, agents/solvers, and scorers.
limits: Course package has not executed this adapter
Security-evaluation orientation may add setup overhead
technologies.security: Use sandboxed tools and explicit scorer/data provenance.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Framework release or target-agent interface change

technologies.name: Ragas
technologies.capability: Metrics for retrieval, generation, RAG, and agent evaluation.
technologies.setup: Python package plus embeddings or judge models for selected metrics
limits: Scores require reference and domain calibration
technologies.security: Sanitize queries, retrieved context, references, and judge inputs.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Metric semantics, embedding, or judge-model change

technologies.name: LangSmith Evaluation
technologies.capability: Evaluate final responses, individual steps, trajectories, retrieval, and generation using datasets and traces.
technologies.setup: LangSmith project, datasets/traces, target and evaluators
limits: LLM-as-judge must be aligned to human labels
technologies.security: Apply trace redaction, retention controls, and least-privilege access.
technologies.refresh_trigger: Evaluator, trace schema, dataset, or product release change

technologies.name: NIST AI RMF Core
technologies.capability: Structure repeatable governance, measurement, validation, monitoring, and response activities around AI risk.
technologies.setup: Map framework outcomes to the product's owners, risks, evidence, and gates
technologies.security: Use it to define ownership and evidence, not as a compliance badge.
fallbacks: organization-specific risk and quality control matrix
technologies.refresh_trigger: NIST revision or organizational policy change
